company.shortDescription: Verata provides a B2B SaaS intelligence platform combining company data, executive profiles, and search management for executive search.
company.description: Verata provides a B2B SaaS intelligence platform that combines company intelligence, executive data, backchannel discovery, and mandate management in one place. The platform aggregates professional and financial information on millions of executives and private companies, including revenue estimates, transaction histories, headcount trends, and ownership context. Users can run AI-powered industry and executive searches, map markets, and evaluate candidates with timelines that tie performance outcomes to specific tenures. Verata also supports backchannel discovery by computing tenure overlaps and surfacing potential reference contacts such as former colleagues, supervisors, and board members. Integrated mandate management tools let teams track search pipelines, score candidates against structured requirements, synthesize interview feedback, and generate client-ready reports. The service is designed for private equity talent teams, institutional investors, corporate talent leaders, and executive search firms conducting senior-level searches and portfolio talent work.
